name: Auburn Hills
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Auburn Hills, MI: SEA LIFE's Elf on the Shelf search, the LEGOLAND Holiday Workshop and breakfast with Santa.
lede: Auburn Hills keeps Christmas indoors at Great Lakes Crossing, with an Elf on the Shelf search at an aquarium, a holiday workshop at LEGOLAND and a Santa breakfast.
celebrates: Christmas in Auburn Hills centers on the Great Lakes Crossing area, where two indoor attractions run holiday programs. SEA LIFE Michigan hosts The Sea Star Search with The Elf on the Shelf from November 20 to January 3, and LEGOLAND Discovery Center Michigan runs The Holiday Workshop from December 3 to 24. Both are included with admission. Rainforest Cafe at Great Lakes Crossing adds a breakfast with Santa. Because everything is under a roof, the town is a good bet when snow or cold rules out an outdoor tree lighting. The city's recreation department also holds Breakfast with Santa at the Community Center on December 12.
lastyear: Auburn Hills families have used the Great Lakes Crossing attractions for indoor holiday outings in past seasons, and local calendars again list the area's holiday programming for 2026. We did not find a host recap of a specific 2025 event for this page, so this section does not describe one. The 2026 listings come straight from SEA LIFE Michigan and LEGOLAND Discovery Center Michigan, each of which posts its dates on its own site.
facts: SEA LIFE Michigan is at 4316 Baldwin Road in Auburn Hills, and the 2026 Elf on the Shelf search is included with admission, which starts from $29.99 per person. LEGOLAND Discovery Center Michigan is also on Baldwin Road, with tickets from $21.99. Both attractions are fully indoors. The two sit close together at Great Lakes Crossing Outlets, so many families visit both in a day.

faq: How does Auburn Hills celebrate Christmas?

Mostly with indoor attractions at Great Lakes Crossing. SEA LIFE Michigan runs an Elf on the Shelf search through January 3, LEGOLAND Discovery Center Michigan runs a Holiday Workshop through December 24 and Rainforest Cafe hosts a breakfast with Santa. All three are indoors, so winter weather does not matter.
Are the Auburn Hills Christmas events indoors?

Yes. SEA LIFE Michigan, LEGOLAND Discovery Center Michigan and Rainforest Cafe are all indoors, which suits snowy days. All three sit around Great Lakes Crossing, so you can pair a morning attraction with a Santa breakfast or lunch without driving far in winter weather.
How much do the Auburn Hills holiday programs cost?

The Sea Star Search and the Holiday Workshop are included with admission, so there is no extra charge for the holiday programs. SEA LIFE tickets start from $29.99 per person and LEGOLAND tickets start from $21.99, according to each attraction's website. Check the sites for ticket types and the day you plan to visit.
How long do the Auburn Hills holiday events run?

The Sea Star Search at SEA LIFE Michigan runs from November 20, 2026 to January 3, 2027, with hours of 10 am to 6 pm. The Holiday Workshop at LEGOLAND Discovery Center Michigan runs from December 3 to 24, 2026, during regular attraction hours. Both are listed on the attractions' own websites.
